paragraphs: In the morning, measure vegetation cover and record sample plot data. At midday, return to the station to calculate grazing capacity and revise rotational plans. In the afternoon, discuss water and fire prevention with ranchers and mediate disputes. Reinspect during droughts, then write monitoring reports and submit them regionally before leaving.
